## 3. Academic Programs & Courses Offered

### Program 1: Class 11 Physics (Core Board & Competitive Foundation)
- Target Audience: Class 11 students (CBSE, AHSEC / Assam State Board)
- Duration: 1 Year (Full Academic Session)
- Syllabus Covered:
  - Mathematical Tools: Differentiation, integration, vectors, graphs
  - Units, Dimensions, and Error Analysis
  - Kinematics: Motion in a straight line, projectile motion, relative velocity
  - Laws of Motion & Friction: Free body diagrams, circular dynamics
  - Work, Energy, and Power: Conservative forces, collisions, conservation laws
  - System of Particles & Rotational Motion: Moment of inertia, torque, rolling motion
  - Gravitation: Kepler's laws, gravitational potential, orbital mechanics
  - Mechanical Properties of Solids & Fluids: Elasticity, viscosity, Bernoulli's theorem
  - Thermal Physics & Thermodynamics: Laws of thermodynamics, heat engines, Carnot cycle
  - Kinetic Theory of Gases & Oscillations (SHM)
  - Waves: Sound waves, Doppler effect, standing waves
- Deliverables: Bi-weekly tests, chapter-wise question banks, NCERT line-by-line solutions, formula handbooks.

### Program 2: Class 12 Physics (Board Excellence & Entrance Mastery)
- Target Audience: Class 12 students preparing for CBSE Board Exams, AHSEC Board Exams, and competitive tests
- Duration: 1 Year
- Syllabus Covered:
  - Electrostatics: Electric charges, Coulomb's law, Gauss theorem, electric potential, capacitance
  - Current Electricity: Kirchhoff's laws, Wheatstone bridge, potentiometer, heating effects
  - Magnetic Effects of Current & Magnetism: Biot-Savart law, Ampere's law, cyclotron, earth's magnetism
  - Electromagnetic Induction (EMI) & Alternating Currents (AC): Faraday's laws, Lenz's law, LCR resonance, transformers
  - Electromagnetic Waves
  - Optics: Ray optics, optical instruments, wave optics, Huygens' principle, interference, diffraction
  - Dual Nature of Radiation & Matter: Photoelectric effect, de Broglie wavelength
  - Atoms & Nuclei: Bohr model, nuclear fission and fusion, radioactive decay
  - Semiconductor Electronics: p-n junction diodes, rectifiers, transistors, logic gates
- Deliverables: Comprehensive revision sheets, board-style mock exams with answer key grading, NCERT exemplar problem solving.

### Program 3: NEET Physics Mastery (Medical Entrance & Repeaters / Dropper Batch)
- Target Audience: NEET-UG aspirants (Class 11, Class 12, and 1-year Droppers/Repeaters)
- Duration: 1 Year / 2 Years
- Focus: Speed, high accuracy, formula recall, eliminating negative marking, and solving 45 questions in 45-50 minutes.
- Features: 15+ years of solved NEET and AIPMT past questions, grand multi-chapter mock tests simulating NTA exam pressure, daily practice problem (DPP) sets.

### Program 4: JEE Main & Advanced Physics
- Target Audience: Engineering aspirants targeting IITs, NITs, and IIITs
- Focus: Multi-concept problem solving, calculus-based derivations, rigorous numerical practice, and advanced analytical tricks.

### Program 5: Assam CEE (Combined Entrance Examination) Coaching
- Target Audience: Students seeking admission to state engineering colleges in Assam (AEC, JEC, etc.)
- Focus: High-speed question solving, past 10 years Assam CEE papers, targeted physics syllabus optimization.

### Program 6: NDA Physics & Foundation
- Target Audience: National Defence Academy candidates
- Focus: Clear physical intuition, general science fundamentals, previous year NDA question patterns.

## 4. Modes of Study
1. Offline Coaching Batches: Conducted at the Hatigaon center in Guwahati in small, distraction-free batches.
2. Home Tutoring in Guwahati: One-on-one personal home tutor visits across Guwahati (Hatigaon, Beltola, Dispur, Ganeshguri, Christian Basti, Bhangagarh, Panbazar).
3. Online Live Interactive Classes: Hybrid access with live streaming, digital notes, and video recordings.
